groups.title: D1 — calendar fields → ISO, add, until and Duration relativeTo near the limits (temporalCompat)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release ports proposal-temporal a41eb67 (+ af0cb4b) and becomes GMT's @js-temporal/polyfill floor (upstream-issue draft C)

groups.title: D2 — buddhist read through ICU4C's Julian/Gregorian hybrid
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains 2bb6ba1 (already on main)

groups.title: D3 + D4 — Hebrew years <= 0 (polyfill leap-year %, ICU4C one day off)
groups.trigger: BOTH a js-temporal release ports proposal-temporal 0df570c AND GMT's engines.node floor bundles an ICU containing 5267bb5778 (ICU-23007)

groups.title: D5 — Indian before ISO year 1 (stale V8 bug 10529 detector)
D6 — non-ISO until re-constrains the day while counting months
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains 10aeb98 (already on main)

groups.title: D7 — Hebrew until by years throws mixed-sign (tc39/proposal-temporal#3159)
D10 — fields → ISO skips a 5–6-day month 13 in far years (tc39/proposal-temporal#3329; ethioaa, so coptic and ethiopic)
groups.trigger: js-temporal ports tc39 #3292 together with the #3329 fix (0.5.1 predates #3292, so this group passes today: it guards against a port of #3292 alone)

groups.title: D11 — the calendar nudge window is never retried, so total, round and until with a calendar smallestUnit answer over the wrong bounds (relativeTo on the 29th-31st)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains js-temporal/temporal-polyfill#361's 50d66d2, which ports proposal-temporal #3172 (5dd0b0d97ee1, the fix for tc39 #3168) and retries the nudge window; merged to main in PR #361 as 5af905f, so no new filing is needed

groups.title: D12 — a zoned string's offset written with seconds is matched by minutes instead of exactly (zonedWallClock.ts defect 4)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains 23d1275 ("Normative: Require strict matching with a precise ZonedDateTime offset", on main)

groups.title: D13 — two offset changes inside one 14-day transition search step are skipped, or stall the search for ever (zonedWallClock.ts defect 5)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release on which EVERY D13 probe returns the spec value, the stall.* probes within 20,000 offset reads. a79c6a1 (per-zone search windows, on main, in no release) alone is not enough: its 17-day window for Africa/El_Aaiun holds three offsets in April 1976, so stall.nextElAaiun fails there (not filed)

groups.title: D9 — non-ISO months added and counted one month at a time (heap OOM for in-range amounts; temporalCompat/largeMonthSpan.ts)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release adds and differences non-ISO months in bounded work: each D9 probe reads at most 100 Intl dates for 1,200 months

groups.title: zoned.A — wall clock → exact time at the range limits (zonedWallClock.ts defect 1, zonedWallClockDifference.ts defect 1)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release contains 05ce7a3 (the max.* probes) and 95237e0 (the min.* probes); both are on main

groups.title: zoned.B — next transition missed near the maximum (zonedWallClock.ts defect 2)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release fixes GetNamedTimeZoneNextTransition near the maximum (upstream-issue draft B; not fixed on main)

groups.title: zoned.E — transition search floored at 1847-01-01 (zonedWallClock.ts defect 3)
zoned.D — UTC fast path skips IsValidEpochNanoseconds (zonedWallClockDifference.ts defect 2)
groups.trigger: a js-temporal release validates the UTC fast path of GetPossibleEpochNanoseconds (upstream-issue draft D; not fixed on main)
